decisions.reason: Although it draws on the firm's core bread-making knowledge, its disappearance from the website after 2019 suggests weak distinctiveness or demand, so resources are better shifted to stronger core lines and new development.
The product is well within existing confectionery capabilities, but not being observed after 2019 indicates limited traction or priority, reducing the value of further incremental learning.

As a farmhouse bread very close to established bakery skills, ingredients, and customers, it fits the firm's absorptive capacity well and can be improved through routine production and sales feedback.
This flagship seasonal stollen is tightly linked to the firm's traditional strengths and its gold award signals that existing knowledge can be commercialised successfully with low withdrawal risk.
